summary_en: ShinMaywa Industries updated its capital-cost and share-price-conscious management targets on 25 June 2026. Specific revised metrics and horizons detailed in attached materials.
title_en: Notice of Update on Measures toward Realization of Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Share Price
translation_en_brief: On 25 June 2026, ShinMaywa Industries' board of directors reviewed and updated its response framework for realizing capital-cost and share-price-conscious management. The notice is brief and refers to attached materials for detailed metrics, targets, and time horizons. No specific numeric targets, KPI thresholds, or payout-ratio floors are disclosed in the headline notice itself; the full terms are contained in supplementary documentation.
